name: dither-text
title: Dither text
description: Display text whose letters are filled with a dithered gradient, noise, dots or hatching in any palette colour, kept as real, selectable text.

name: dissolve-text
title: Dissolve text
description: Text that dissolves in through Bayer thresholds by character, word or line, in any order, settling solid or into a dithered texture.

name: scramble-text
title: Scramble text
description: Text that resolves character by character through dithered blocks and glyphs, with no layout shift, on mount, in view, hover or text change.

name: dither-number
title: Dither number
description: An animated number with tabular digits that roll or resolve through a dither, Intl formatting, prefix and suffix, colour and size presets.
